instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a 'Dark Mode Only' design. Force the 'dark' class on the html element.
Use 'Playfair Display' for all Headings (H1-H3) to give that 'Senior Executive' feel. Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text.
Create a 'Noise' overlay component that sits fixed on top of everything with pointer-events-none to give a film grain texture.
For the 'Problem' section, use a Bento Grid layout with 'Glass Crystal' cards.
For the 'Pricing' section, do NOT use a standard pricing table. Use 'Investment Framing' cards that look like executive briefs.
The 'Contact' form should feel like a VIP inquiry. Minimal fields, high-end typography.
Use the 'Tracing Beam' effect for the main CTA or the 'Offer' cards.
Ensure all text has high contrast (APCA compliant).
Do NOT use gradients for text. Keep text solid Slate-50 or Slate-200.
Install 'lucide-react' for icons if not available, but prefer 'phosphor-icons' if possible.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop' - no generic centered layouts.
